O estado da chamada pertence ao worker q: Call state belongs to the worker that initiated it. Sending the termination command to another node puts control in the wrong place.

Recebo os jobs de forma assíncrona pelo: I receive jobs asynchronously through Redis Streams and serialize access to Whisper. Job state follows processing.
Em picos de entrada, aumenta o tempo de: During input spikes, queue waiting time increases. Accepting a job and completing its transcription are different stages.

Sem evidência suficiente, a saída é text: Without sufficient evidence, the output is empty text.
